# Transactions: Get a Transaction From Taxbit

Area overview and notes: [transactions.md](../transactions.md)

`GET /transactions/external-id/{id}` · tenant-scoped token

Retrieve a transaction that was previously ingested by Taxbit using your system's unique identifier for the Transaction.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Transaction. |

**Response 200**: Get transaction response.

| `message` | string | No |  |
